newsitem.title: GREECE: NORWEGIAN TELENOR RANKED FIRST BY GREEK OTE COMTE.
newsitem.headline: NORWEGIAN TELENOR RANKED FIRST BY GREEK OTE COMTE.

text.p: Greek telecom OTE's committee evaluating the technical and financial bids for the selection of a mobile telephony partner graded Norwegian Telenor first and Orange second, it said in a statement.
The committee forwarded its proposal to OTE's board.
OTE wants to be the third provider of mobile telephony in Greece. Panafon and Telestet are the other two mobile telephony providers in the country whose technology is based on GSM.
Panafon and Telestet have asked the council of state not to allow OTE to develop its own mobile telephony system which is based on DCS 1800 technology. A court decision is pending.
The two companies were awarded licences for mobile systems in 1992 and the contracts gave them exclusive operating rights for eight years. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
